easy: Very big and exciting, like a great adventure.

ex.en: We watched an epic movie about a long journey across the sea.
ex.ko: 우리는 바다를 건너는 긴 여행을 그린 웅장한 영화를 봤다.

easy: Having to do with a very long poem about a hero.

ex.en: The teacher read us an epic story about a brave hero.
ex.ko: 선생님은 용감한 영웅에 관한 서사시 이야기를 읽어 주셨다.

easy: A very long poem that tells the story of a brave hero.

ex.en: We read an epic about a hero who sailed across the sea.
ex.ko: 우리는 바다를 건넌 영웅에 관한 서사시를 읽었다.

easy: Leaving someone or something out on purpose.

ex.en: Everyone can come to the party, with the exception of the dog.
ex.ko: 강아지만 빼고 모두 파티에 올 수 있다.

easy: Something that does not follow the usual rule.

ex.en: Most birds can fly, but penguins are an exception.
ex.ko: 대부분의 새는 날 수 있지만 펭귄은 예외다.

easy: A door or opening you use to go out of a place.

ex.en: Walk to the nearest exit if the fire alarm rings.
ex.ko: 화재 경보가 울리면 가장 가까운 출구로 걸어가세요.

easy: The act of going out of a place.

ex.en: The actor made his exit from the stage.
ex.ko: 배우는 무대에서 퇴장했다.

easy: Pictures and ideas that you make up in your mind.

ex.en: In her fancy, the white clouds were big fluffy sheep.
ex.ko: 그녀의 상상 속에서 하얀 구름은 크고 폭신한 양이었다.

easy: A liking for something.

ex.en: I have a fancy for strawberry ice cream.
ex.ko: 나는 딸기 아이스크림을 아주 좋아한다.

easy: The feeling people get about you when they first meet you.

ex.en: She made a good impression on her new teacher.
ex.ko: 그녀는 새 선생님께 좋은 인상을 남겼다.

easy: To be a sign of something.

ex.en: Dark clouds indicate that rain is coming.
ex.ko: 먹구름은 비가 올 것을 나타낸다.

easy: To show where something is or which way to go.

ex.en: The sign indicates the way to the library.
ex.ko: 표지판이 도서관 가는 길을 가리킨다.

easy: To hit something hard so that it moves.

ex.en: The ball knocked the cup off the table.
ex.ko: 공이 컵을 쳐서 탁자에서 떨어뜨렸다.

easy: To tap on a door with your hand to let people know you are there.

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
ex.ko: 들어오기 전에 문을 두드려 주세요.

easy: To hit against something hard by accident.

ex.en: I knocked my knee against the desk.
ex.ko: 나는 책상에 무릎을 부딪쳤다.

easy: Strong, soft material made from animal skin, used for shoes and bags.

ex.en: My baseball glove is made of brown leather.
ex.ko: 내 야구 글러브는 갈색 가죽으로 만들어졌다.

easy: Something nice that you enjoy but do not really need.

ex.en: A big swimming pool at home is a luxury.
ex.ko: 집에 있는 큰 수영장은 사치품이다.

easy: The quality of being very fancy and costly.

ex.en: The hotel was full of luxury, with golden chairs and soft beds.
ex.ko: 그 호텔은 금빛 의자와 푹신한 침대로 호화로움이 가득했다.

easy: Covered with paint.

ex.en: The painted fence looked bright and new.
ex.ko: 페인트칠한 울타리가 밝고 새것처럼 보였다.

easy: Asking many people what they think to find out the most popular answer.

ex.en: Our class took a poll to pick a favorite pizza topping.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 가장 좋아하는 피자 토핑을 고르려고 설문조사를 했다.

easy: Liked better than other things.

ex.en: Tea is the preferred drink at our house.
ex.ko: 우리 집에서는 차가 더 선호하는 음료다.

easy: The act of using force to move something toward you.

ex.en: Pulling the wagon up the hill was hard work.
ex.ko: 언덕 위로 수레를 끌어 올리는 것은 힘든 일이었다.

easy: A person whose job is to find out news and tell it to people.

ex.en: A reporter came to our school to write about the science fair.
ex.ko: 기자가 과학 박람회에 대한 기사를 쓰러 우리 학교에 왔다.

easy: To take things from someone by force or by breaking the law.

ex.en: The thief tried to rob the bank, but the police caught him.
ex.ko: 도둑이 은행을 털려고 했지만 경찰이 잡았다.

easy: To cover a long stretch of land.

ex.en: The beach stretches for miles along the sea.
ex.ko: 해변이 바다를 따라 몇 마일이나 펼쳐져 있다.

easy: To reach out your arms or legs to loosen your body.

ex.en: I stretch my legs before soccer practice.
ex.ko: 나는 축구 연습 전에 다리를 쭉 편다.

easy: To make something straight and long by pulling it out.

ex.en: He stretched out the rope until it was straight.
ex.ko: 그는 줄이 곧게 될 때까지 쭉 폈다.

easy: To break apart suddenly.

ex.en: The rope tore when the dog pulled too hard.
ex.ko: 강아지가 너무 세게 당기자 밧줄이 끊어졌다.

easy: To pull something apart with force.

ex.en: I tore the paper in half.
ex.ko: 나는 종이를 반으로 찢었다.

easy: To run very fast.

ex.en: The dog tore across the yard after the ball.
ex.ko: 강아지가 공을 쫓아 마당을 쏜살같이 달렸다.

easy: A game where two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets.

ex.en: I play tennis with my dad on Saturdays.
ex.ko: 나는 토요일마다 아빠와 테니스를 친다.

easy: A wild animal like a big dog that often lives and hunts in a group.

ex.en: The wolf howled at the bright full moon.
ex.ko: 늑대가 밝은 보름달을 향해 울부짖었다.

easy: When someone or something is not there.

ex.en: The teacher noticed the absence of my homework.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 숙제가 없다는 것을 알아차리셨다.

easy: Not being at a place where you should be.

ex.en: Her absence from school lasted three days.
ex.ko: 그녀의 결석은 사흘간 이어졌다.

easy: The time when someone is away.

ex.en: Our dog behaved well during Dad's absence.
ex.ko: 아빠가 안 계신 동안 우리 개는 얌전히 있었다.

easy: Having to do with farming.

ex.en: Corn and wheat grow on agricultural land.
ex.ko: 옥수수와 밀은 농업용 땅에서 자란다.

easy: Having to do with farming and farm life.

ex.en: Long ago, ours was an agricultural town where most people grew food.
ex.ko: 오래전 우리 마을은 대부분의 사람이 농사를 짓던 농업 마을이었다.

easy: A slow, sad kind of music that began with Black Americans in the United States.

ex.en: Grandpa plays the blues on his guitar.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 기타로 블루스를 연주하신다.

easy: A sad, down feeling.

ex.en: I got the blues when my best friend moved away.
ex.ko: 가장 친한 친구가 이사 가서 나는 우울해졌다.

easy: A grown-up male cow.

ex.en: The bull stood in the field next to the barn.
ex.ko: 황소가 헛간 옆 들판에 서 있었다.

easy: To give money or help to a good cause.

ex.en: Every student contributed a dollar to help the animal shelter.
ex.ko: 모든 학생이 동물 보호소를 돕기 위해 1달러씩 기부했다.

easy: To help make something happen.

ex.en: Sleeping well contributes to doing better at school.
ex.ko: 잠을 잘 자는 것은 학교생활을 더 잘하는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: The help you give to get something done.

ex.en: Each kid's contribution made our class project great.
ex.ko: 아이들 한 명 한 명의 기여 덕분에 우리 반 프로젝트가 훌륭해졌다.

easy: Something, such as money, that you give to help a good cause.

ex.en: We made a contribution to the food bank.
ex.ko: 우리는 푸드뱅크에 기부를 했다.

easy: The act of giving together with other people to help those in need.

ex.en: Our class's contribution helped the animal shelter.
ex.ko: 우리 반의 기부가 동물 보호소에 도움이 되었다.

easy: Tasting very, very good.

ex.en: Grandma's apple pie is so delicious!
ex.ko: 할머니의 사과 파이는 정말 맛있다!

easy: To say that something is not true.

ex.en: Tom denied eating the last cookie.
ex.ko: 톰은 마지막 쿠키를 먹지 않았다고 부인했다.

easy: To refuse to believe something that is true.

ex.en: He denied that he was sick, even though he had a fever.
ex.ko: 그는 열이 있는데도 아프다는 것을 부정했다.

easy: To say no to what someone asks for.

ex.en: Mom denied my request to stay up late.
ex.ko: 엄마는 늦게까지 깨어 있게 해 달라는 내 부탁을 거절하셨다.

easy: When something is not hard to do.

ex.en: She solved the puzzle with ease.
ex.ko: 그녀는 퍼즐을 쉽게 풀었다.

easy: To make something bigger or cover more people or places.

ex.en: The park extended its hours so more kids could play.
ex.ko: 공원은 더 많은 아이들이 놀 수 있도록 운영 시간을 늘렸다.

easy: When many people know and admire who you are.

ex.en: The singer gained fame all over the world.
ex.ko: 그 가수는 전 세계에서 명성을 얻었다.

easy: The good things that people say about you.

ex.en: Our school has a good fame for its great band.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 훌륭한 밴드로 좋은 명성을 얻고 있다.

easy: Passed down from parents to children.

ex.en: Brown eyes are a genetic trait from my mom.
ex.ko: 갈색 눈은 엄마에게서 물려받은 유전적 특징이다.

easy: Having to do with genes, the tiny parts of cells that tell a body how to grow.

ex.en: Genes carry genetic information from parents to children.
ex.ko: 유전자는 부모에게서 아이에게 유전 정보를 전달한다.

easy: Two pieces of glass in a frame that you wear to help you see.

ex.en: I wear glasses to see the board in class.
ex.ko: 나는 수업 시간에 칠판을 보려고 안경을 쓴다.

easy: Feeling that someone or something is very good.

ex.en: I was impressed by how high she could jump.
ex.ko: 나는 그녀가 높이 뛰는 모습에 감명받았다.

easy: Happening right away with no waiting.

ex.en: Her answer was instant.
ex.ko: 그녀의 대답은 즉각적이었다.

easy: Watching something carefully, sometimes writing down what you see.

ex.en: Monitoring the weather helps farmers plan their work.
ex.ko: 날씨를 관찰하면 농부들이 일을 계획하는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: A basic idea or rule that guides how to act or how things work.

ex.en: A basic principle in our house is to be kind.
ex.ko: 우리 집의 기본 원칙은 친절하게 대하는 것이다.

easy: A rule about doing what is right.

ex.en: She has a principle never to tell a lie.
ex.ko: 그녀는 절대 거짓말을 하지 않는다는 원칙이 있다.

easy: A basic fact about how something works.

ex.en: Scientists learn the principles of how airplanes fly.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 비행기가 나는 원리를 배운다.

easy: Liking new ideas and wanting to make things better.

ex.en: Our school is progressive and tries new ways to teach.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 진보적이어서 새로운 가르침 방식을 시도한다.

easy: A big meeting where many people cheer and show support.

ex.en: The whole school came to the pep rally before the big game.
ex.ko: 큰 경기 전에 전교생이 응원 집회에 모였다.

easy: When a team finds new energy and starts to catch up.

ex.en: Our team started a rally in the last inning.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 마지막 회에 반격을 시작했다.

easy: A person who likes to read.

ex.en: My sister is a big reader and finishes a book every week.
ex.ko: 내 여동생은 책을 아주 좋아해서 매주 한 권씩 다 읽는다.

easy: A person who pays to get a magazine or newspaper regularly.

ex.en: She is a reader of this kids' magazine and gets it every month.
ex.ko: 그녀는 이 어린이 잡지의 구독자라서 매달 받아 본다.

easy: A person who knows how to read.

ex.en: Now that I'm a good reader, I can read street signs.
ex.ko: 이제 나는 글을 잘 읽어서 길거리 표지판도 읽을 수 있다.

easy: A picture or model that shows someone or something.

ex.en: This drawing is a representation of our school.
ex.ko: 이 그림은 우리 학교를 그린 것이다.

easy: Speaking or acting for other people.

ex.en: Each class has representation on the student council.
ex.ko: 각 반은 학생회에 대표를 두고 있다.

easy: The place or family that your family comes from.

ex.en: My roots are in Korea, where my grandparents were born.
ex.ko: 내 뿌리는 조부모님이 태어나신 한국에 있다.

easy: To move your arm or a bat in a curve to hit something.

ex.en: She swung the bat and hit the ball.
ex.ko: 그녀는 방망이를 휘둘러 공을 쳤다.

easy: To turn around quickly in a curve.

ex.en: The car swung around the corner.
ex.ko: 자동차가 모퉁이를 돌며 방향을 틀었다.

easy: The part at the back end of an animal's body.

ex.en: My dog wags his tail when I come home.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 내가 집에 오면 꼬리를 흔든다.

easy: The last part of something.

ex.en: We came in at the tail end of the movie.
ex.ko: 우리는 영화 끝부분에 들어갔다.

easy: Something that looks like an animal's tail.

ex.en: The kite had a long tail of ribbons.
ex.ko: 연에는 리본으로 된 긴 꼬리가 달려 있었다.

easy: Going to happen soon.

ex.en: I'm excited about the upcoming school trip.
ex.ko: 나는 곧 있을 학교 소풍이 기대된다.

easy: Watching closely and ready for anything.

ex.en: The alert dog barked when the doorbell rang.
ex.ko: 경계하던 개가 초인종이 울리자 짖었다.

easy: Quick and full of energy.

ex.en: The alert puppy ran happily around the yard.
ex.ko: 민첩한 강아지가 마당을 신나게 뛰어다녔다.

easy: Awake and thinking clearly.

ex.en: I feel alert after a good breakfast.
ex.ko: 나는 든든한 아침밥을 먹으면 정신이 또렷해진다.

easy: A grown-up male goat.

ex.en: The billy goat chewed on the fence.
ex.ko: 숫염소가 울타리를 씹고 있었다.

easy: A deep, loud sound that lasts for a while.

ex.en: We heard the boom of thunder across the sky.
ex.ko: 우리는 하늘을 가로지르는 천둥의 굉음을 들었다.

easy: A time when many people have jobs and businesses make lots of money.

ex.en: The town had a boom after the new factory opened.
ex.ko: 새 공장이 문을 열자 마을은 호황을 맞았다.

easy: Not afraid to face danger or hard things.

ex.en: The brave boy jumped into the pond to save the kitten.
ex.ko: 용감한 소년이 새끼 고양이를 구하려고 연못에 뛰어들었다.

easy: Not afraid of anything.

ex.en: The brave little girl walked alone into the dark cave.
ex.ko: 대담한 작은 소녀가 혼자 어두운 동굴로 걸어 들어갔다.

easy: A long line of people or things, one behind another.

ex.en: A column of ants marched across the sidewalk.
ex.ko: 개미 행렬이 인도를 가로질러 지나갔다.

easy: Numbers or words lined up from top to bottom.

ex.en: Write the answers in the right column of the chart.
ex.ko: 답은 표의 오른쪽 열에 쓰세요.

easy: To do something bad that is against the law or rules.

ex.en: The thief committed a crime and ran away.
ex.ko: 도둑이 죄를 저지르고 도망쳤다.

easy: To give all your time and effort to something.

ex.en: She committed herself to practicing piano every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 매일 피아노 연습에 전념했다.

easy: Money paid to make up for a loss or for work done.

ex.en: The store gave me compensation for the broken toy.
ex.ko: 가게는 망가진 장난감에 대해 나에게 보상을 해 주었다.

easy: The act of paying or giving something back for work or for something lost.

ex.en: I got a sticker as compensation for helping.
ex.ko: 나는 도와준 보상으로 스티커를 받았다.

easy: What something is made of.

ex.en: The composition of this soil is sand and small rocks.
ex.ko: 이 흙의 구성은 모래와 작은 돌이다.

easy: Allowed by the main rules of a country's government.

ex.en: Free speech is a constitutional right.
ex.ko: 표현의 자유는 헌법상의 권리다.

easy: Going from one side to the other.

ex.en: Our boat crossing of the lake took an hour.
ex.ko: 우리가 배로 호수를 건너는 데 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: A place where two roads or paths meet.

ex.en: Look both ways at the crossing before you walk.
ex.ko: 건너기 전에 건널목에서 양쪽을 살펴보세요.

easy: Trying to stop the other team from scoring.

ex.en: The defending players stood near the goal.
ex.ko: 수비하는 선수들이 골대 근처에 서 있었다.

easy: How hard something is to do.

ex.en: We talked about the difficulty of the math test.
ex.ko: 우리는 수학 시험의 난이도에 대해 이야기했다.

easy: Having to do with the first years of school.

ex.en: I go to an elementary school near my house.
ex.ko: 나는 집 근처 초등학교에 다닌다.

easy: Basic and simple.

ex.en: Learning to count is an elementary skill.
ex.ko: 숫자를 세는 법을 배우는 것은 기본적인 기술이다.

easy: To help something grow and get better.

ex.en: Good teachers foster a love of reading.
ex.ko: 좋은 선생님들은 독서를 좋아하는 마음을 키워 준다.

easy: To take care of someone else's child in your home for a while.

ex.en: My aunt and uncle foster children who need a home.
ex.ko: 이모와 이모부는 집이 필요한 아이들을 위탁 양육한다.

easy: To help something grow stronger.

ex.en: My teacher fosters my love of art.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내가 미술을 좋아하는 마음을 북돋워 주신다.

easy: Basic and very important.

ex.en: Reading is fundamental to learning.
ex.ko: 읽기는 배움의 기본이다.

easy: Changing the main part of something in a big way.

ex.en: Moving to a new country was a fundamental change in my life.
ex.ko: 새로운 나라로 이사한 것은 내 삶의 근본적인 변화였다.

easy: A person who is amazingly smart.

ex.en: Mozart was a child genius who wrote music at age five.
ex.ko: 모차르트는 다섯 살에 작곡을 한 천재 아이였다.

easy: Amazing ability to think or make things.

ex.en: Her genius for math amazed her teacher.
ex.ko: 그녀의 수학 천재성은 선생님을 놀라게 했다.

easy: Someone who is super good at something.

ex.en: He is a genius at chess.
ex.ko: 그는 체스의 천재다.

easy: By a very large amount.

ex.en: My reading has improved greatly this year.
ex.ko: 올해 내 읽기 실력이 크게 늘었다.

easy: Help and advice about what to do.

ex.en: The school counselor gave me guidance about choosing a club.
ex.ko: 학교 상담 선생님이 동아리 고르는 것에 대해 조언해 주셨다.

easy: Showing someone the way.

ex.en: With the guide's guidance, we found the trail.
ex.ko: 안내자의 안내 덕분에 우리는 등산로를 찾았다.

easy: What you plan to do or want to happen.

ex.en: My intention is to finish my homework before dinner.
ex.ko: 내 목적은 저녁 전에 숙제를 끝내는 것이다.

easy: A plan in your mind to do something.

ex.en: It was never my intention to hurt your feelings.
ex.ko: 네 마음을 아프게 할 의도는 전혀 없었어.

easy: The joint in the middle of your leg that lets it bend.

ex.en: I scraped my knee when I fell off my bike.
ex.ko: 나는 자전거에서 넘어져 무릎이 까졌다.

easy: Using machines or tools.

ex.en: The toy robot has a mechanical arm that moves.
ex.ko: 그 장난감 로봇에는 움직이는 기계 팔이 있다.

easy: Having to do with machines and tools.

ex.en: My uncle has mechanical skills and fixes cars.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 기계 다루는 솜씨가 있어서 자동차를 고치신다.

easy: Taking part in an activity with other people.

ex.en: Participation in the school play is fun.
ex.ko: 학교 연극에 참여하는 것은 재미있다.

easy: Sharing in something with other people.

ex.en: Everyone's participation made the clean-up fast.
ex.ko: 모두가 참여해서 청소가 빨리 끝났다.

easy: Money you pay regularly so insurance will help if something goes wrong.

ex.en: Dad pays an insurance premium each month for our car.
ex.ko: 아빠는 매달 우리 자동차 보험료를 내신다.

easy: A leader in some Christian churches who leads church services.

ex.en: The priest welcomed the families to church.
ex.ko: 신부님이 가족들을 교회에서 맞아 주셨다.

easy: A person who leads prayers and ceremonies in a religion.

ex.en: A priest at the temple leads the prayers.
ex.ko: 절에서는 성직자가 기도를 이끈다.

easy: Easy to see or very important.

ex.en: The tall tower is a prominent sight in our city.
ex.ko: 높은 탑은 우리 도시에서 눈에 띄는 명소다.

easy: Asked for.

ex.en: The teacher brought the requested book.
ex.ko: 선생님은 요청받은 책을 가져오셨다.

easy: Meant for people to live in.

ex.en: Our street is a quiet residential area with many houses.
ex.ko: 우리 동네는 집이 많은 조용한 주거 지역이다.

easy: Two round metal circles hung on ropes that gymnasts hold and swing on.

ex.en: She held the rings tight and swung up.
ex.ko: 그녀는 링을 꽉 잡고 몸을 위로 흔들어 올렸다.
